definitions.explanation: A person who listens, especially to a story, speech, or conversation. Emphasizes the receiving role in communication.
The person conducting an interview or asking questions in a dialogue, as opposed to the person being interviewed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{聞|き}き{手|て}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかむ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧だ。
examples.english: She is skilled at capturing the hearts of her listeners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{聞|き}き{手|て}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The impression a story makes changes depending on the listener.

examples.japanese: {聞|き}き{手|て}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}した→質問する：05637_shitsumonsuru⟧。
{聞|き}き{手|て}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力量|りきりょう}→力量：18764_rikiryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦インタビュー→インタビュー：03833_intabyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The quality of an interview depends on the interviewer's skill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対談|たいだん}→対談：19950_taidan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{聞|き}き{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}めた→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: In this conversation, a famous author served as the interviewer.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to listen) + ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (person/doer), following the common pattern where ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ indicates the person performing the action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{聞|き}き{手|て} — good listener
- {聞|き}き{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧ — to serve as interviewer
- {聞|き}き{手|て}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧ — the listener's perspective

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{話|はな}し{手|て}→話し手：28073_hanashite⟧ — speaker (the opposite role)
- ⟦{利|き}き{手|て}→利き手：19086_kikite⟧ — dominant hand (homophone with different kanji)
- {読|よ}み{手|て} — reader (same ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ pattern)
